findings.claim: - R7's "shares of wages" is shown as contribution rates (owner decision, 2026-10-23, after rounds 6 and 7): chart 3's title, axis, labels, note and alt text give rates, and the post states JP's wage ceiling in its prose only.
findings.evidence:
L: I checked every clause of design doc line 143 against the files and could not refute any of them.

(1) Chart 3 gives contribution rates on every surface.
- PNG: I opened charts/jh-3-contributions.png. Its sha256 is 60b288b7..., the same as site public/images/blog/jh-3-contributions.png.
- Title: 'Contribution rates each year, worker and employer' (make_charts.py:167).
- X-axis: 'Contribution rate, percent' (make_charts.py:166).
- Bar labels: '37%', '12.1%', '5.7%', '3%', with no 'of pay' (make_charts.py:160). The y-tick labels are scheme names, so 'labels' can only mean the bar labels, as r7:item:4 recorded.
- Note: 'the rates the regulations set'; 'the average deferral rate'; 'the average total contribution rate'; 'CPF Board contribution rates' (make_charts.py:171-176). The MDX figcaption at :79-83 has the same text.
- Alt text: 'Bar chart of contribution rates each year, worker and employer: ... 37 percent ... 12.1 percent on average among participants ... 5.7 percent ... 3 percent' (gate.toml:74; MDX:78; 9.json '[published] alt:jh-3-contributions.png').
- Draft image alt: 'Contribution rates each year, worker and employer' (.md:50, .src.md:50).

(2) 'Contribution rates' is true of all four bars.
- JHT: PP 46/2015 Pasal 16(1), 'Iuran JHT ... sebesar 5,7% ... dari Upah' (pp_46_2015.txt:426-430).
- JP: PP 45/2015 Pasal 28, '3% (tiga persen) dari Upah per bulan' (pp_45_2015.txt:820-825).
- CPF: the data.gov.sg dataset is titled 'CPF contribution rates' (data/README.md:97).
- 401(k): How America Saves 2026 calls the 12.1% 'Average total contribution rate (participant and employer)' (vanguard_how_america_saves_2026.txt:224, sha256 34b506ce... matches sources.json). Its body text reads 'the average total participant contribution rate in 2025 was 12.1%' (:2560-2562), and Figure 44 is titled 'Aggregate participant and employer contribution rates' (:2612). The worker part is HAS's 'Average participant deferral rate' 7.6% (:214).
- Round 8's deletion of 'the rules set' was correct: no rule sets the 401(k) bar. The narrowed wording holds for all four bars.

(3) The post states JP's wage ceiling in its prose only.
- 'ceiling' occurs exactly once across all published texts in .rounds/9.json: the JP sentence, 'takes another 3 percent of its members' wages, up to a ceiling' (draft .md:13; MDX:22).
- It does not occur in make_charts.py, the PNG note, gate.toml alt text, the MDX figcaption, the excerpt or the meta description (grep, no hits).
- JHT has no ceiling (provenance-audit.md:63), so there is no second ceiling the bullet leaves out.
- 8.json and 9.json differ only in the 'round' key.

(4) The owner decision and its date match the records.
- r6 fix: 'Owner decision of 2026-10-23 (rate framing)'. r7:item:3 fix: 'Owner decision of 2026-10-23 (after round 7)'.
- In rounds.jsonl, round 6 closed at 2026-10-24T00:37:04Z and round 7 at 01:04:32Z. Converted with zoneinfo, these are 20:37 and 21:04 EDT on 2026-10-23, matching A5's 'New York time'.
- File times agree: make_charts.py, gate.toml and the PNG were modified at 21:03 EDT on 10-23, and the design doc at 21:53 EDT.

(5) The wording is right.
- 'R7's "shares of wages"' quotes R7 at design doc :63.
- No leftover 'rules set' wording exists anywhere in the project outside sources/. | K: TEXT AND DIFF: docs/2026-10-21-jht-401k-design.md:143 matches inventory item 1 exactly (script comparison: True). A word diff against the round 8 claim (round8-verdicts.json r8:item:4) shows only two deletions, ['the'] and ['the','rules','set'], with nothing added (lens-K/worddiff.py). git diff confirms the line exists only in the uncommitted working copy.

AGAINST R7 (:63-65): R7 reads 'Shares of wages, worker and employer shown separately' and covers four bars: JHT, JP, 'a typical 401(k) from How America Saves 2026' and CPF. The narrowed phrase 'contribution rates' is accurate for all four. JHT and JP: the chart note says 'the rates the regulations set (PP 46/2015 Pasal 16; PP 45/2015 Pasal 28)', and gate.toml:34-35 calls them 'contribution rate'. 401(k): Vanguard's own row names are 'Average participant deferral rate' (sources/text/vanguard_how_america_saves_2026.txt:214) and 'Average total contribution rate (participant and employer)' (:224). A2 (:114-117) uses the same terms. CPF: the dataset is titled 'CPF contribution rates'. provenance-audit.md:593 already heads section G 'What each contribution rate in R7 is a share of'. So round 8 removed the 401(k) overreach ('rules set') and introduced no new conflict.

AGAINST THE A5 HEADER (:134, 'No rule R1 to R8 and no result changes'): results.json contributions are unchanged: cpf 20/17/37, jht 2/3.7/5.7, jp 1/2/3, k401 7.6/4.5/12.1 (2024). These are the values in the round 6 and 7 evidence, so the bullet records a relabel, not a result change.

AGAINST ROUNDS 6 AND 7: the round 6 fixes (r6:extra:S0, L1, H2, H3, K4, K5) say 'Owner decision of 2026-10-23 (rate framing)'. The round 7 fix (r7:item:3) says 'Owner decision of 2026-10-23 (after round 7): JP's on wages up to a ceiling removed from chart 3's alt text and note ... the post's JP sentence keeps its ceiling.' Both match the bullet's '(owner decision, 2026-10-23, after rounds 6 and 7)' and 'the post states JP's wage ceiling in its prose only'. rounds.jsonl gives round 6 closing at 2026-10-24T00:37Z and round 7 at 01:04Z, which is 20:37 and 21:04 EDT on 2026-10-23.

AGAINST THE PAGE AND CHARTS: I opened charts/jh-3-contributions.png.
